items.title: Cosimo Matassa Interview, 1993-07-17
items.q: Decca, Brotney, and Tommy. I'm never telling you the story now.

ctx.x: Oh, one of those kind. Yeah. Unbelievable.
And, in fact, they forced us to re-record the song. Decca, Brotney, and Tommy. I'm never telling you the story now. We were the original Freedom Riders about that.
Right. We went up on a train. Train.
